ideas.pitch: A multi-modal freight and last-mile delivery route optimization tool tailored for tier-2 and tier-3 Indian logistics constraints.
ideas.problem_statement: Open Innovation – major logistics and mobility challenges in India
ideas.title: NammaRoute India
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly tackles practical feasibility and scalability by solving a real Indian supply chain bottleneck, echoing previous logistics hackathon wins.

ideas.pitch: A cold-chain and transport marketplace connecting rural agricultural cooperatives directly with urban cold storage trucks to minimize perishable food waste.
ideas.problem_statement: Open Innovation – agricultural supply chain and mobility gaps in India
ideas.title: AgriTransit Direct
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines high societal impact with a clear market model, impressing judges looking for practical feasibility and commercialization potential.

ideas.pitch: An integrated commuter platform that unifies real-time public transit tracking, auto-rickshaw pooled booking, and EV charging station availability in congested urban metros.
ideas.problem_statement: Open Innovation – urban mobility and public transportation congestion in India
ideas.title: SmartCommute Multi-Transit Hub
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets a universally experienced urban pain point in India with a clear UI demo that scores high on clarity of presentation and technical depth.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered predictive battery health and maintenance monitoring dashboard for commercial electric 3-wheeler fleets in India.
ideas.problem_statement: Open Innovation – EV adoption and fleet management challenges in India
ideas.title: EV Fleet Guardian
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns with future-of-mobility themes and demonstrates technical depth through telemetry data processing and predictive alerting.

ideas.pitch: A crowdsourced dashcam video intelligence pipeline that automatically detects, logs, and geotags road hazards and traffic bottlenecks for municipal repair action.
ideas.problem_statement: Open Innovation – road safety and municipal infrastructure challenges in India
ideas.title: PotholeVision AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages computer vision for high visual impact during the 3-5 minute demo video, securing strong marks on innovation and functionality.
